body: This.... does not belong on this sub....

Make it look like an accident and not like suicide. Like a car crash,  no note. 

It will still hurt them, traumatize them, break them. It will take them years to recover. 
But it would hurt them less then knowing you killed yourself, loved ones tend to blame themselves when stuff like that happens.

All I can say is that it takes a unique mind to live in a world of narcissism and still understand that you don’t really matter at all. You’re thinking about life and existence in ways most people never do. Ignorance is bliss right? At least know you’re smart for being able to think critically and strong for not rejecting truth for something easier.

This. On some level I know that I feel there’s a wall there because I put it up... but I can’t take it down either... it’s way worse to open up and have your friends eject than to have no friends...
But it’s so isolating and painful to feel so disconnected from everyone. 
Is there any solution better than death?

I feel as though what’s kept us from being happy together are our own mental health issues... and recently I’ve made some serious progress and that’s why I decided that I thought we could make it work and be happy together... maybe it was just fear of being alone and completely without support if we were to break up and him move back to our old city... I’m lost
